acceptance: `docs/agent/batch-tracker-contract.md` lists every site a catalog pin change touches, in the same form as the wheel-upgrade list, or a make target updates them and the doc names that target.

A stale rollout evidence file after a pin change is reported by a fast check (`make skill-sync-check` or `make skill-integrity-check`) with a message naming the file, not only by the medium integration test.
A pin change made by following the documented steps passes `make pr-preflight` on the first run.
description:
Moving the catalog `rev` in `skill-sync.conf` and running `make skill-sync` is not enough. `tests/integration/worktree/test_batch_skill_delivery.py::test_pin_receipt_and_tracked_mirror_bind_catalog_tip` also requires `_project/analysis/batch-rollout-evidence.json` (`catalog.merge_revision`, `catalog.parent_revision`, `catalog.pr`, `benchbox_pin.before/after`, both `receipt_revision` values and every changed mirror hash for `.claude/skills/todo` and `.agents/skills/todo`) and the `DELIVERY_CATALOG_REV` constant in that test to match the new pin. `docs/agent/batch-tracker-contract.md` lists the sites for a tractable wheel upgrade but says nothing for a catalog pin change, and `make skill-sync-check` and `make skill-integrity-check` both pass while the evidence is stale. On 2026-11-12 this was found only when `make pr-preflight` failed after a six-minute test run; the fix was copied from the previous pin change (#4102).

Decision gate: document the sites, or remove the hand step by having a target rewrite the evidence from the receipt. Prefer the second only if the evidence file's other consumers (`scripts/pr_landing.py`, the comment-policy scope check) do not depend on it being hand-reviewed.
